description: npm renewal mechanism (coding-policy: dependency-management Freshness — 'Automate it where a scanner supports the ecosystem: a committed Dependabot or Renovate config'). Covers the two npm manifests (root package.json, container/agent-runner/package.json). Scoped to the npm manager via enabledManagers so it does not overlap the docker ecosystems handled by .github/dependabot.yml. Requires the Renovate GitHub App installed on the repo/org to run.
Package-rules mirror the repo's dependabot cadence: weekly, chore-typed commits, minor+patch grouped to keep the PR volume low; majors land as individual reviewable PRs.
